notes: GT CropYield_T column has a trailing space: 'CropYield_T ' - use exact name with space
GT CropYield_T _SD and CropYield_T _N also have trailing spaces in column names
GT effect column is response ratio (RR = T/C), extraction uses percent change ((T-C)/C * 100); conversion: RR = 1 + effect_pct/100
Unit mismatches exist across papers: some extraction papers report kg/ha, others t/ha, g/pot, kg/m2
Paper 016_Li_B_2016 reports cumulative yield over 9 crops (t/ha total), GT may store per-season values
Paper 101_Liang_Feng_2014 reports total over 4 seasons, GT may store per-season values
Paper 078_Wang_2012 uses g/pot units which need conversion to match GT scale
Paper 082_Jose_2013 uses g/pot (dry grain biomass) units
Paper 001_Adekiya_2019 uses kg/m2 which needs conversion to t/ha (factor 10) or match GT scale
Papers 077_Zhang_J_2019, 126_Arif_2017, 130_Azeem_2019, 153_Wei_2022, 184_Yeboah_2018, 219_Xie_2021, 227_Niu_2017, 242_Liu_2014 use kg/ha while GT may store t/ha
GT dataset has CropYield values ranging from 0.12 to 206, suggesting mixed units (some t/ha, some g/pot or other)
StudyIDs in GT go up to at least 80 based on sample, extraction papers map to IDs beyond 80 (101, 116, etc.) - verify these exist in full GT
The GT dataset is a subsample of ~40 studies from 367, so not all extraction papers may have GT matches

effect_direction.note: GT uses RR = T/C (response ratio), extraction uses percent change = (T-C)/C * 100. Convert: RR = 1 + effect_pct/100. Both are positive when treatment > control.

control_definition_notes.gt: Control (CK) - typically no biochar, may or may not include fertilizer depending on study design
control_definition_notes.extraction: Control varies by paper - some are absolute no-amendment controls, others are fertilized controls without biochar
control_definition_notes.note: Some studies use factorial designs where control includes fertilizer but no biochar (BN treatment vs N treatment). GT CK definition should be verified per study.
